rows 1-6: the gate's escapes judged at contact; gate: its own acceptance with its 4 m margin; search: green = an escape found; outer bound: red = proven unsafe.
n / α in a cell: the escape law's load-factor / angle-of-attack cap bound on over 15% of its frames
